figurative_meaning_en: in every vein, deep within the blood
example_sentences_in_bangla: শিরায় শিরায় বিষ চলছে, তাই এতো রাগ।
example_sentences_in_english: Fire is burning in his every vein.
Poison is running through his veins, that's why he's so angry.
note: Often used to describe intense anger or deep-seated feelings in Bengali literature and speech.
